item.title: Tech Rout Deepens as Earnings Stoke AI Fears
item.description:
Tech stocks and US equity futures fell as another batch of disappointing earnings intensified the selloff in the sector, as investors increasingly question the payoff from massive artificial intelligence spending.
The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Gold Slips Below $4,000 on Hot Inflation, Tech-Stock Rout
item.description: Gold fell below $4,000 an ounce — on track for a second monthly loss — as rising oil prices added to inflationary pressures and a tech-stock rout raised the risk of investors selling the metal to cover losses.

item.title: Weil Gotshal Private Equity Partner Blakey to Jump to Simpson
item.description: A Weil Gotshal & Manges private equity partner, Lewis Blakey, in London is set to move to Simpson Thacher & Bartlett, marking the latest exit from the stricken Wall Street law firm, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
